claim: The game's online services use WB's backend at kraken-api.wbagora.com with a custom zlib-compressed binary value protocol and endpoints /auth, /access, /ssc/invoke and /broadcast_channels; a community rebuild of this server exists.
evidence: request_tester.py sets base_url kraken-api.wbagora.com; nemesis/src/routes register /auth, /access, /ssc/invoke.
verification_method: Read source at pinned commit. Could be checked by a static string search for wbagora in a copied exe; never by contacting the host.
limitations: EULA 1(b) forbids software that emulates or redirects WB's protocols; we will not use, emulate or contact this backend. Single source.
next_experiment: Static string search only; design the co-op transport fully separate (own peer link) and block the mod from touching WB endpoints.
